**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

- The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Bluefly. All hits for "exclusive" are unrelated (§ 5.2 exclusive warranties, §§ 5.4/12.1 nonexclusive licenses, § 4.3 tax-exclusive charges), and there are no "all requirements", sole-source, or minimum-volume commitments in the charges (§ 4.1) or services (§ 13.1) provisions.
- § 14.11 (No Resale) restricts only resale of the Services — it does not limit our ability to procure from other suppliers.
- § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) affirmatively preserves each party's right to enter similar agreements with others, satisfying the preferred position.
